name: tsmc
description: Telegram Serverless Media Center — media center chạy hoàn toàn trong trình duyệt

scripts.predeploy: npm run build:web && npm run build:sw
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run predeploy && npx --yes firebase-tools hosting:channel:deploy preview --expires 7d
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run predeploy && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --only hosting
scripts.build:web: node libs/worker-host/build.mjs && pnpm --filter web run build
scripts.dev: node libs/worker-host/build.mjs && pnpm --filter web run start
